data.body: **[P2] Keep MDC-capture failure unwrapping bounded.** This callback reaches `finishInvocation`, which uses the unbounded `ExceptionHelper.unwrapCompletableFuture`. An MDC adapter throwing a `CompletionException` with a cyclic cause hangs the worker and caller before any hooks run; a null or unreadable cause can also replace the original failure. Use an identity-tracked safe unwrap that preserves the wrapper for cyclic, null, or unreadable causes, and add capture-side regression tests.
